patch_description: Apply an unconditional small SG polish only in quiet regions (small slope magnitude), then a localized slope-magnitude-conditional smoothing pass using the existing hysteresis machinery with a stricter slope gate. The key idea: slope changes (79.6) and false reversals (58.4) come from residual dithering in flat regions where |slope| is small relative to a robust slope scale. Smooth only there with a small zero-phase order-2 SG kernel (window 5), blending via np.where, so genuine transitions keep their responsiveness. This avoids the failure mode of extra global SG passes (Gens 82-85) by conditioning on local slope magnitude rather than applying everywhere.
